Vaccine mandates are authoritarian.

President Biden should trust Americans to make the best healthcare decisions for themselves – not the federal government – and encourage people to talk to their doctors.

I was shocked to find out that the CMS proposed National Coverage Determination (NCD) severely restricts Medicare coverage for a whole class of Alzheimer’s treatments, including the recently FDA-approved Aduhelm, to only cover these drugs in CMS-approved clinical trials.

@RepKevinBrady, @RepGuthrie, @VernBuchanan and I sent a letter to HHS @SecBecerra urging him to abandon and re-propose access to FDA-approved Alzheimer’s treatments for a broader population of Medicare beneficiaries. Read:
https://t.co/OYXaDyc8v8

If we want to end cancer as we know it today, one fewer treatment or cure is one too many.

That’s why @POTUS's plan for government price controls is not the answer.

Analysis from @UChicago shows his drug pricing scheme will lead to as many as 135 FEWER new drugs & cures.

Today, on #WorldDownSyndromeDay, I am reminded of how grateful I am for the huge influence my son Cole has had on my life & our family. I could have never imagined when we first got the diagnosis of his extra 21st chromosome just how positively he would impact this world.

🚨 CMS finalized its Medicare Advantage and Medicare Part D rule.   

I’m still reviewing the rule’s other policies, but I am pleased they are addressing DIR fees, which have been unfairly manipulated to drive up drug prices and patients’ out-of-pocket costs.

Today we pay homage to those who answered America’s call in her darkest hours & laid down their life for freedom. We remember how they gave their final breath so we did not have to; so we could sleep in peace knowing we were free & safe from all evil. 

May God watch over them. https://t.co/j6YYmfoZDv

Thanks to Spokane’s own Earl Moore & everyone at the Coalition for Medicare Choices for surprising me with the Medicare Advantage Champion Award! I’m so grateful & look forward to our continued work together to ensure seniors have access to high-quality, affordable health care. https://t.co/MmWcYmGxiq
I’m joining @A1Policy to discuss putting patients FIRST in healthcare and more. Tune-in soon at 10:00am ET!

Putting America first in health care means putting patients in charge and trusting them to make the best decisions for themselves. 

Watch my discussion with @A1Policy ↓ https://t.co/rEi8M9R3ux

That’s why @RepBradWenstrup, @RepJimBanks & I are leading on legislation to affirm that every person’s life has value by expanding the BAN of QALYs to all federal programs. Read: 
https://t.co/k9XAdRue6T

The pandemic has made clear that telehealth can and should be a part of modernizing health care delivery in America.

While I support today’s legislation, it’s a missed opportunity to do even more for patients and health care providers. https://t.co/dwg91eOrMl

The Democrats’ Inflation Expansion Act will make inflation worse, raise taxes, make America more reliant on China’s supply chains, destroy lifesaving cures and treatments, and make energy and healthcare MORE expensive.
https://t.co/WQ3ca232UT

Meet Dr. Francis.

As a doctor treating pregnant women, she cares for two patients at once – a mother and a baby.

Read how she’s dedicated her life to human rights, specifically the right to life. ↓ 
https://t.co/8tBWcrkc0J

American seniors can’t afford to make ends meet and are being forced out of retirement because of President Biden’s inflation and rising cost-of-living crisis.

Yet, @POTUS is touting minimal Medicare Part B premium “decreases.” My full statement:
https://t.co/dW0Ruy3Ow4

The average standard monthly Medicare Part B premiums have NOT decreased under @POTUS. 
 
In fact, savings have been swallowed up by this year’s 14.5% increase in premiums.

Playing politics and spinning seniors’ Medicare "savings” is especially outrageous considering the program’s looming insolvency.
https://t.co/dW0RuxMLu4

President Biden refuses to acknowledge that mandating a cap on insulin copays fails to address the root cause of insulin prices.

Instead, it will lead to higher premiums for all seniors, and if he gets his way, ALL Americans.

President Biden’s socialist price control scheme means #FewerCures. 

If we are to end cancer as we know it, lead the world in medical innovation, and beat China, one fewer cure or treatment is one too many.

Despite the President’s lies and fear mongering, Republicans are committed to strengthening Medicare and Social Security so it is sustainable for generations to come. 
https://t.co/cUnAKdA3mN

🎙️ Tomorrow is #RareDiseaseDay. Don't miss my chat with @patientsrising on why I'm leading to ban #QALYs, which discriminate against people with disabilities and chronic illnesses. https://t.co/LMVZvNJvU3

Patients all over the country are hopeful that Congress may finally work together to address the health care cost and complexity, and I’m proud @HouseCommerce continues to lead the way. https://t.co/VRfNlfJk3k

Today is National Nurses Day! Thank you to the dedicated men and women who work around the clock to deliver the best care to patients in Eastern Washington and across the country. We appreciate everything you do! https://t.co/GqY4RDKZZ5
